translations.预设场景类型，先检查角色契约，再生成可检查的普通节点。 固定值：\"comman: Preset type: role contracts are checked before ordinary inspectable nodes are created. Constant: "command_response", request/response delay pairing.
translations.阈值预设的signal角色使用的分析信号name；必须满足该角色的数值与单位要求: Analysis signal name for the threshold preset's signal role. It must satisfy that role's numeric type and unit requirements.
translations.阈值单位，可省略并使用signal角色所绑定信号的单位；显式填写时必须与该信号一: Threshold unit. Optional; defaults to the bound signal role's unit. An explicit unit must match the signal and does not cause additional conversion.
translations.阈值活动的进入门槛，单位与角色信号一致；与退出门槛的先后关系由方向语义检查。: Entry threshold for threshold activity, in the role signal's unit. Direction semantics determine its ordering relative to the exit threshold.
translations.阈值活动的退出门槛，不能为消除抖动而擅自猜测数值。: Exit threshold for threshold activity. Do not guess a value to suppress fluctuation.
translations.预设场景类型，先检查角色契约，再生成可检查的普通节点。 固定值：\"thresh: Preset type: role contracts are checked before ordinary inspectable nodes are created. Constant: "threshold_excursion", threshold activity that enters on excursion and exits on recovery.
translations.针对指定CAN消息的逐消息累计。每次实际消息独立求值，不施普通信号保持、不额外乘: Per-message accumulation for selected CAN messages. Each actual message is evaluated independently; ordinary signal holding is not applied and no extra time difference is multiplied in.
translations.逐消息累计使用的原始CAN来源name；只有一个适用来源时可省略，多候选时必须明: Raw CAN source name for message accumulation. May be omitted when exactly one applicable source exists; multiple candidates require a choice.
translations.消息读取/解码实现标识，可省略并由来源确定：既有BLF路径使用sclicer-f: Message reader/decoder implementation. Optional and determined by the source: the existing BLF path uses sclicer-functions-v1; ASC, raw CAN CSV, and mixed sources use can-text-v1. An explicit value must match the source.
translations.逐消息计算的累计方法，可省略，当前默认且仅支持legacy_sum；每条符合条件: Message accumulation method. Optional; legacy_sum is currently the only supported method and the default. Each qualifying message contributes once independently.
translations.可省略，默认current_message-v1；每次只取当前目标消息的解码值，: Optional, defaulting to current_message-v1. Use only the current target message's decoded values, without retaining a previous message's cached values.
translations.是否扩展帧，必须是布尔值；标准帧ID与扩展帧ID有不同范围。 固定值：false: Extended-frame flag, which must be Boolean. Standard and extended frame IDs have different ranges. Constant: false.
translations.CAN报文ID，非负整数；范围由标准帧/扩展帧标志进一步约束。: Non-negative integer CAN message ID, further constrained by the standard/extended frame flag.
translations.触发求值的CAN报文定位；frame_id必填，channel省略采用来源通道，: CAN message that triggers evaluation. frame_id is required; channel defaults to the source channel. Standard/extended and CAN/FD constraints are optional and otherwise identified from actual input.
translations.按当前原解码字段的正负选择累计桶，不施额外归一化，也不沿用其他消息的旧值。: Select positive/negative accumulation buckets using the current raw decoded field, without extra normalization or reuse of another message's old value.
translations.用于区分正负方向的分析信号name，须来自同一目标报文；允许独立于贡献expr。: Analysis signal name used to distinguish positive/negative direction. It must come from the same target message but may be independent of contribution expr.
translations.正值桶或负值桶的选择；方向判断依据当前指定原解码字段。可选值：\"positiv: Select the positive or negative bucket according to the specified current raw decoded field. Options: "positive", positive-value bucket; "negative", negative-value bucket.
translations.分组使用的值，可省略，默认raw_decoded-v1；使用本条消息的原解码方向: Value basis for grouping. Optional, defaulting to raw_decoded-v1: use this message's original decoded direction value without extra conversion or reuse of old values.
translations.带单位的间隔文本，或有独立unit声明的表达式数值参数；按所在对象检查类型。: Interval text with a unit, or a numeric expression parameter with a separate unit declaration. Type requirements depend on the containing object.
translations.数值计算实现选择。两后端服从相同业务语义，不表示所有规则都会数组化。可选值：\": Numeric implementation. Both backends follow the same business semantics; the setting does not mean every rule is vectorized. Options: "numpy", NumPy implementation; "reference", independent reference implementation.
translations.每批读取的记录/样本上限，正整数，默认65536；不等于独立任务并行数。: Maximum records/samples per read batch. A positive integer defaulting to 65536; it is not the number of parallel independent tasks.
translations.新分析层内存预算，正整数字节数，默认268435456；不是整个Python进程: Memory budget for the new analysis layer. Positive bytes, default 268435456. It is not an RSS limit for the entire Python process or legacy reader.
translations.写出结果前的缓冲行数上限，正整数，默认4096。: Maximum buffered result rows before writing. A positive integer defaulting to 4096.
translations.超过预算的处理方式，当前只接受error，明确失败而不丢数据或增加旧输入扫描。: Budget-exceeded behavior. Currently only error is accepted: fail explicitly without dropping data or adding scans of the legacy input. Constant: "error".
translations.暂存磁盘配额，正整数字节数；null或省略表示未设置配额。: Temporary-disk quota in positive integer bytes. null or omission means no quota is set.
translations.执行后端及分析层资源限制。预算是声明，静态检查不测量实际内存峰值。: Execution backend and analysis-layer resource limits. A declared budget is not a static measurement of peak memory.
translations.是否保存逐消息贡献明细。none默认只保留汇总，full显式逐条保存。可选值：\: Whether to save individual message contributions. none is the default and keeps summaries only; full explicitly saves every contribution. Options: "none" and "full".
translations.结果表格式；省略时使用readable_csv，中文列名、精确秒、同区间指标合并: Result table format. Defaults to readable_csv: Chinese column names, exact seconds, and metrics for the same interval combined into one row. csv retains flat interchange tables and integer nanoseconds; jsonl retains one JSON object per line. Only the selected table set is generated. This does not select the configuration file format.
translations.运行清单文件格式，当前固定json。 固定值：\"json\"。: Run-manifest format. Currently fixed to json. Constant: "json".
translations.显式选择要导出的原信号别名列表；必须已在分析signals中声明，不默认导出全部: Explicit list of original signal aliases to export, already declared in analysis signals. All signals are not exported by default.
translations.明确选择整个会话、某条规则的事件范围或某个窗口的范围。: Explicitly select the whole session, events from a rule, or the range of a window.
translations.明确允许线性重采样的数值信号子集。状态、计数或枚举不能仅因数值类型就被当成连续量: Numeric signals explicitly allowed to use linear resampling. State, counter, and enum signals must not be treated as continuous merely because their dtype is numeric.
translations.允许插值或重建的最大实际样本间隔，必须带单位且为正；不是固定时间偏移。: Maximum actual sample gap permitted for interpolation or reconstruction. A positive duration with a unit, not a fixed time offset.
translations.导出网格周期。固定周期使用正时长文本，DBC周期使用mode: dbc对象；不从: Export grid period. Use a positive duration string for a fixed period, or a mode: dbc object for a DBC cycle. Periods are not inferred from filenames.
translations.重采样时间网格的起点，省略为0ns；不改变分析范围或原始报文时间。: Origin of the resampling time grid, defaulting to 0ns. It does not change the analysis range or original frame timestamps.
translations.本次导出的独立重采样设置。省略或null保留原始采样；不能借导出网格改变计算间隔: Independent resampling settings for this export. Omission or null keeps original sampling; an export grid must not change the calculation interval.
translations.可选的信号CSV导出。省略或null表示关闭；开启时必须明确选择信号及范围。: Optional signal CSV export. Omission or null disables it. Enabling it requires an explicit signal selection and scope.
translations.CAN输出格式，asc或blf；与结果表csv/jsonl选项分开。可选值：\": CAN output format, separate from csv/jsonl result tables. Options: "asc", ASC text frames; "blf", BLF binary frames.
translations.使用所有已配置窗口生成的范围，不把all当作某个窗口名。: Use ranges from all configured windows. all is not interpreted as a window name.
translations.导出时间以相对起点还是Unix纪元表示。原始时间解释必须明确。可选值：\"rel: Export time coordinates, relative to an origin or absolute Unix epoch. The original time interpretation must be explicit. Options: "relative" and "epoch".
translations.显式捕获日期，用于需要日期头的导出；不能把运行日期冒充采集日期。: Explicit capture date for exports requiring a date header. The run date must not be substituted for the acquisition date.
translations.导出时间轴的显式固定偏移，带s/ms/us/ns单位，不改变分析时钟。: Explicit fixed offset for exported timestamps, with s/ms/us/ns. It does not change the analysis clock.
translations.重建时必须保留原值的DBC信号列表，例如计数器或校验字段；不自动重算未知算法。: DBC signals whose original values must be preserved during reconstruction, such as counters or checksum fields. Unknown algorithms are not recomputed automatically.
translations.CAN重建规则列表，按精确报文定位声明连续字段和受保护字段。: CAN reconstruction rules, locating messages precisely and declaring continuous fields and protected fields.
translations.没有匹配重建规则的报文如何输出：按原时间透传，或按明确距离选择最近原帧。可选值：: Output for messages without a matching reconstruction rule. Options: "passthrough", preserve original frames and timestamps; "nearest", select the nearest original frame within an explicit time distance.
translations.选择最近原帧时允许的最大时间距离，必须为非负时长；0s仅接受恰好同刻的原帧。: Maximum allowed time distance when selecting the nearest original frame. A non-negative duration; 0s accepts only an original frame at exactly the same timestamp.
translations.采集地点的固定时区，例如+08:00或UTC；相对时间导出BLF时与captur: Fixed acquisition timezone, such as +08:00 or UTC. For BLF export of relative timestamps, provide it together with capture_date.
translations.导出时间以相对起点还是Unix纪元表示。原始时间解释必须明确。 固定值：\"ep: Export time coordinates, relative to an origin or absolute Unix epoch. The original time interpretation must be explicit. Constant: "epoch", absolute Unix epoch time.
translations.可选的CAN原帧/重建帧导出。省略或null表示关闭，开启不会替代分析结果表。: Optional original/reconstructed CAN frame export. Omission or null disables it; enabling it does not replace the analysis result tables.
translations.分析结果表和可选信号/CAN导出设置。输出在实际运行后发布到新目录。: Analysis result tables and optional signal/CAN exports. After an actual run, outputs are written to a new directory.
translations.请求开始点规则的id，必须已在rules中声明，不能引用活动规则。: Identifier of the request start-point rule, already declared in rules. Activity rules cannot be referenced here.
translations.响应点规则的id，必须引用rules中已定义的rising_edge、falli: Identifier of the response point rule, referencing a rising_edge, falling_edge, or start_only rule defined in rules. This is not a signal name or a sequence identifier.
translations.将请求点事件与响应点事件按FIFO配对，指定允许延迟和最多等待的请求数。: Pair request and response point events in FIFO order, specifying allowed delays and the maximum number of pending requests.
translations.未单独覆盖的消费者采用的计算间隔，省略时为actual真实时间差。: Calculation interval used by consumers without a specific override. Defaults to actual observed timestamp differences.
translations.普通时序计算使用的计时间隔。默认真实记录时间差，可对指定消费者覆盖；不改变信号有: Time intervals used by ordinary temporal calculations. Defaults to actual record gaps and can be overridden per consumer. Signal validity is unchanged.
translations.是否生成额外详细追溯，默认false；关闭时仍保留必要结果和错误处理。: Whether to generate additional detailed provenance. Defaults to false; necessary results and error handling remain enabled.
translations.是否执行额外完整性诊断，默认false；不取消普通分析所必需的输入检查。: Whether to run additional integrity diagnostics. Defaults to false; this does not disable input checks required for ordinary analysis.
translations.是否保留本次自有工作现场，默认false；不授权删除或保留无关用户文件。: Whether to retain this run's own working files. Defaults to false; it does not authorize deleting or retaining unrelated user files.
translations.按需开启额外追溯、完整性检查或现场保留。三项独立，默认均关闭。: Opt-in additional provenance, integrity diagnostics, or retention of working files. These three options are independent and all default to off.
translations.明确的本地.json/.yaml/.yml文件路径；相对主配置目录解释，不支持U: Explicit local .json/.yaml/.yml file path, relative to the main configuration directory. URLs and wildcards are not supported.
translations.可选公共定义文件，按列表顺序导入sources/signals/derived，: Optional shared definition files. Import sources/signals/derived in list order, then append this file's declarations. Duplicate names fail; only one import level is allowed. Omission or an empty array means no external definitions.
translations.按已有定义名称填写允许覆盖的字段；不能新增目标、改名或覆盖自由元数据。: Permitted field overrides addressed by existing definition names. Overrides cannot create targets, rename them, or replace arbitrary metadata.
translations.公共定义的显式局部覆盖；必须同时声明imports，未知目标与不允许字段会报错。: Explicit local overrides of shared definitions. imports must also be declared; unknown targets and disallowed fields fail.
translations.数据来源类型，决定使用哪个读取器及其必需字段。可选值：\"memory\"：配置: Source type, selecting the reader and required fields. Options: "memory", ordered records embedded in configuration; "signal_csv", decoded-signal CSV.
translations.数据来源类型，决定使用哪个读取器及其必需字段。可选值：\"can_blf\"：原: Source type, selecting the reader and required fields. Options: "can_blf", raw CAN binary BLF; "can_asc", raw CAN text ASC; "raw_can_csv", raw CAN frame CSV with an explicit layout.
translations.独立批量任务声明。jobs在各任务启动时加载计划；template在加载批量配置: Independent batch tasks. jobs load plans when each task starts; template expands files and compiles independent plans while the batch configuration is loaded, reading DBC metadata if needed but not business records. Consecutive files from one session remain in one analysis plan.
translations.独立批量清单的结构版本，当前固定为整数1；与单个分析计划config_versi: Structural version of the independent batch manifest, currently the integer 1. It is independent of each analysis plan's config_version. Constant: 1.
translations.分析工作进程数量上限，正整数，默认1；不含调度主进程和CAN读取子进程。每个任务: Maximum number of analysis worker processes. A positive integer defaulting to 1; excludes the scheduler parent and CAN reader child processes. Each task has an independent budget.
translations.观察到失败后是否停止派发新任务，默认false；已启动任务完成必要关闭。: Whether to stop dispatching new tasks after observing a failure. Defaults to false; started tasks complete necessary cleanup.
translations.数值计算实现选择。两后端服从相同业务语义，不表示所有规则都会数组化。可选值：nu: Numeric implementation. Both backends follow the same business semantics; not every rule is necessarily vectorized. Options: null, use each plan's backend; "reference", independent reference implementation; "numpy", NumPy implementation.
translations.独立任务列表。按实际启动时读取子计划，坏任务按fail_fast政策隔离；同会话: Independent tasks. Each child plan is read when its task starts; failures are isolated according to fail_fast. Consecutive files from one session must not be split into independent tasks.
translations.任务名称，可省略并按列表位置生成job_1、job_2等；名称必须唯一，忽略大小: Task name. If omitted, generate job_1, job_2, etc. by list position. Names must be unique, including case-insensitive comparison.
translations.子分析计划的YAML或JSON路径，相对于批量清单目录；启动该任务时才加载。: YAML or JSON path for a child analysis plan, relative to the batch manifest directory. Loaded only when the task starts.
translations.用于每个输入文件的分析模板路径，每个文件生成独立任务，不能与jobs同时填写。: Analysis template path used for each input file. Each file creates an independent task; cannot be combined with jobs.
translations.每个输入文件形成独立任务。可填文件、目录、通配符或列表；显式列表保持声明顺序，各: Each input file creates an independent task. Accepts a file, directory, wildcard, or list. Explicit lists keep declaration order; matches use natural order. Directories are not recursive unless an explicit ** wildcard is used.
translations.模板中被替换输入路径的来源名称；模板只有一个来源时可以省略。: Source name whose input path is replaced in the template. May be omitted if the template has only one source.
translations.只共享来源、信号与派生表达式。没有版本包装，不允许嵌套imports；当前结构随: Shares only sources, signals, and derived expressions. No version wrapper or nested imports; the structure is interpreted under the referencing version-3 configuration.
translations.按名称声明派生表达式，与signals共用名称空间；不覆盖先前文件或本文件的同名: Derived expressions declared by name, sharing the signals namespace. They cannot override same-named signals from earlier files or this file.
translations.Chronaxis 旧INI显式映射规范: Chronaxis explicit legacy INI mapping schema
translations.旧INI映射文件自身的结构版本，当前固定整数1；不是analysis内部信号映射: Structural version of the legacy INI mapping file, currently integer 1. This is not the business version of an analysis signal mapping. Constant: 1.
translations.可省略，默认且仅支持mapping_directory。相对路径按实际声明文件目: Optional; defaults to and currently only supports mapping_directory. Relative paths use the directory of the file that declares them; shared definitions and overrides retain their own source locations.
translations.可省略，默认且仅支持explicit_mapping；输入和输出采用analys: Optional; defaults to and currently only supports explicit_mapping. Inputs and outputs come from analysis rather than directly reusing legacy INI INPUT/OUTPUT paths.
translations.当前config_version=3的分析声明主体；来源、信号和显式分析设置由调: Analysis body for current config_version=3. The caller provides sources, signals, and explicit analysis settings. Node sections generated by INI conversion must remain empty.
translations.原INI变量到analysis信号name的映射。可省略或部分填写：原字段名仅对: Mapping from original INI variables to analysis signal names. Optional or partial: a uniquely matching original field is filled automatically, explicit mappings take precedence, and multiple candidates require a choice.
translations.由原INI段生成的窗口名称，必须唯一且不与其他节点冲突。: Window name generated from an original INI section. It must be unique and must not conflict with other nodes.
translations.逐消息求值政策，当前固定current_message-v1，只使用当前消息的明: Message evaluation policy, currently fixed to current_message-v1, using only explicit fields of the current message. Constant: "current_message-v1".
translations.触发本计算求值的精确CAN消息定位，包含通道、帧ID、标准/扩展及CAN FD标: Exact CAN message that triggers this calculation, including channel, frame ID, standard/extended type, and CAN FD flag.
translations.原INI数值参数名到单位的明确映射，不能从名称或示例数值猜量纲。: Explicit units for original INI numeric parameter names. Dimensions must not be guessed from names or example values.
translations.原INI段到生成节点及业务参数的映射。显式填写时逐段对应；single/star: Mapping from original INI sections to generated nodes and business parameters. Explicit mappings correspond section by section. single/start_only/start_end may omit the mapping entirely, generating trigger_N/window_N in order; legacy_sum and slope still require unit or mode parameters.
translations.JSON/YAML共用的INI迁移映射。明确来源与业务参数，唯一原字段可自动对应: INI migration mapping shared by JSON and YAML. Sources and business parameters are explicit; unique original fields can match automatically, and CAN metadata may be supplied from DBC as needed. The original INI is preserved; failure does not return a partial plan.
translations.配置版本3保持旧单位规则，版本4支持兼容单位自动换算。默认采用真实记录间隔、关闭: Version 3 retains the original unit rules. Version 4 automatically converts compatible units. The default uses actual record intervals, with contributions and extra diagnostics off. AnalysisPlan checks references, units, drivers and nanosecond bounds.
translations.分析配置结构编号。接受整数3或4；3保持旧单位和显式转换行为，4使用单位扩展和默: Analysis configuration version: integer 3 or 4. Version 3 retains legacy units and explicit conversion; version 4 supports additional units and automatic conversion by default. There is no separate semantic_version.
translations.版本4的一维标定表，供lookup函数按名称引用。输入轴在其声明单位中严格递增，: Version 4 one-dimensional calibration tables referenced by name in lookup. Input coordinates must strictly increase in their declared unit. Step interpolation retains the fixed-width output type.
translations.表达式引用的唯一表名。: Unique table name used by expressions.
translations.标定轴单位，兼容的查询输入按此单位换算。: Calibration axis unit. Compatible query values are converted to this unit.
translations.返回标定值的单位。: Unit of the returned calibration value.
translations.按输入从小到大排列的[输入,输出]数值对。有限轴、定宽整数和精度由加载器核验。: Numeric [input, output] pairs in ascending input order. The loader checks finite coordinates, fixed-width integers and precision.
translations.v4 枚举的原始整数类型。enum_code 使用；CAN 可由无缩放整数 DB: Original integer type of a version 4 enum, used by enum_code. The DBC can supply it for unscaled integer CAN signals.
translations.v4 枚举映射前的整数类型，enum_code 按需读取。: Integer type before enum labels are applied in version 4. Only enum_code requests original codes.
translations.当前config_version=3或4的分析声明主体；来源、信号和显式分析设置: Base analysis declaration for config_version 3 or 4. The caller supplies sources, signals and explicit settings. Leave node sections created by INI conversion empty.
translations.按需汇总单次运行中的计算、配对、事件或窗口结果。: Summarize calculations, pairings, events or windows within this run when requested.
translations.选择本次运行要汇总的结果。只引用一个计算、配对、规则或窗口。: Select exactly one calculation, sequence, rule or window from the current run.
translations.对引用的结果行执行的聚合。成功响应的延迟均值和P95只使用已成功配对的延迟。: Operation on the selected result rows. Mean and P95 response delay use successfully matched responses only.
translations.可选数值字段；计算结果默认value，配对默认delay_ns。计数不需要数值字: Optional numeric field. Calculations default to value and sequences to delay_ns. Counts have no numeric field.

Sample statistics weight real samples equally; time statistics use the duration for which a value is valid. select returns matching rows, duration sums true time and integral uses zero-order hold. translations.持续时间与minimum_duration的比较，必须明确填写：>=达到，>严格: Required comparison between the continuous duration and minimum_duration: >= includes the threshold; > requires strictly longer. Exactly 60 seconds satisfies only >=. The activity start is unchanged; selection_origin still defaults to onset.
